title: Random Question Generator - Conversation & Writing Prompts
meta_description: Pick one random conversation or writing prompt. Copy, share, or review recent questions stored in this browser.
intro: Need a prompt for a conversation, journal entry, or group warm-up? Select one question from the built-in list with each click.

sections.h2: How do I generate a random question?
sections.content:
Click Generate to pick one general-audience prompt from the built-in list. Generate again if the first question does not fit the moment.

You can copy the result, share it, or review recent results saved in this browser. The tool does not create questions with AI and it does not accept custom question lists.

sections.h2: What can I use a random question for?
sections.content: Use a question as an icebreaker, a short writing prompt, a meeting warm-up, or a starting point for a one-to-one conversation. The list mixes opinions, everyday experiences, and hypothetical choices, so no specialist knowledge is required.

sections.h2: What should I check before asking a group?
sections.content: Read the question before asking it aloud. Skip anything that feels too personal for the group, and allow people to pass. For lessons or facilitated sessions, choose the prompt yourself when safeguarding, accommodations, or learning goals require more control.

faq.question: Can I add my own questions?
faq.answer: No. This version selects from a fixed built-in list.

faq.question: Does the tool use AI to write questions?
faq.answer: No. Each result is selected from a maintained list in the page code.

faq.question: Are recent questions uploaded?
faq.answer: Recent results are stored in this browser. Technical request data may still be handled by the site's hosting, analytics, advertising, and security providers.
